value.rationale: The canonical smallest quartic girth-five cage has four natural edge orbit classes (Robertson 1964); completing all of their threshold perturbations yields a meaningful natural full finite classification. Every one-edge deletion raises the unanimous basin and two-cycle diversity simultaneously while destroying fixed points. Contrast with Chvátal graph same-rule analogue where two-cycle count instead decreases; no general or paper-sized theorem is claimed.
